source.printedPageMapping: Printed pp.1–128 map to PDF pp.2–129; PDF1 and PDF130 are unprinted covers.

scope.boundary: The PHB class reviewer owns class summary/abilities beginning with the p.18 Character Classes transition and pp.19–33. This review covers only ability tables/notes, racial eligibility/bounds and race-specific description text. PDF20/printed p.19 was boundary-inspected only. Human class-change procedure at p.33 is outside this page cohort.

method.pixelReview: Original PDF page renders at 216 dpi; each page was delivered and reviewed one image per result with printed folio visible. OCR was not used as proof.
method.siteJoin: Frozen 1,000-owner snapshot; each listed owner has captured rendered detail DOM and public-search document. A captured search document is not a test of query ranking or clicks. `sourceViewerOpened` is false, so source chips were not opened in a live browser.
method.wholeBookLimit: This is a closed page-cohort review, not a whole-PHB audit or exhaustive clause-level denominator.
